caption: The drawing depicts a round, plate-like object with a yellowish-brown base color and greenish and brownish marbling throughout. In the center, there is a symmetrical floral design with a central stem and three large flowers or buds, two on either side and one at the top, all drawn in brown lines. The plant emerges from a rectangular base decorated with brown diagonal cross-hatching. Around the edge of the circular object, there is a decorative brown line interrupted by a wavy border, and outside this is an inscription in a brown script, following the circumference of the plate. The background surrounding the plate is a solid off-white or beige color.
title: Pa. German Dish
